tasks.name: Noxious Foe
steps: Equip a nose peg or Slayer helmet before attacking an Aberrant Spectre.
Use Protect from Magic and kill one spectre in the Slayer Tower. Keep the protective headgear equipped.

tasks.name: Abyssal Adept
steps: Stun the Sire with a shadow spell, destroy its respiratory systems, then fight the boss while avoiding pools and the explosion.
Repeat until you have 20 kills. Restock between trips; these kills do not need to be consecutive.

tasks.name: Abyssal Veteran
steps: Use shadow spells for the respiratory phase; destroy all systems before fighting the Sire itself. Move away from pools and its explosion.
Repeat until you have 50 kills, banking whenever food, prayer or runes run low.

tasks.name: They Grow Up Too Fast
steps: Complete the respiratory phase, then kill each summoned Spawn promptly instead of ignoring the adds.
Keep clearing new Spawns before they mature into Scions, and finish the Sire without letting any mature.

tasks.name: Respiratory Runner
steps: Prepare your respiratory-system weapon and position before stunning the Sire.
Stun once, then destroy every respiratory system during that stun. Finish the kill without casting another stun.

tasks.name: Don't Whip Me
steps: Stun the Sire before attacking its respiratory systems and attack them from outside tentacle reach.
Keep away from the external tentacles throughout the kill. Protection prayer does not make a tentacle hit acceptable.

tasks.name: Demonic Rebound
steps: Bring Vengeance runes on the Lunar spellbook and keep enough Hitpoints to survive the explosion.
Cast Vengeance for the Sire explosion, deliberately survive the hit, and let the reflected damage strike the Sire.

tasks.name: Don't Stop Moving
steps: Keep run energy available for the later phases and move as a miasma pool appears beneath you.
Continue attacking from clear tiles until the Sire dies; do not cross an active pool to regain attack range.

tasks.name: Perfect Sire
steps: Stun before clearing respiratory systems; stay outside external tentacle reach and use the correct protection prayer against the Sire.
Move off miasma pools immediately and retreat from the explosion. Finish without damage from any listed mechanic.

tasks.name: Kree'arra Adept
steps: Bring Ranged equipment, prayer restoration and food. Use Protect from Missiles while fighting Kree'arra.
Clear the bodyguards between kills and repeat until 50 kills. Bank when supplies run low.

tasks.name: Kree'arra Veteran
steps: Use a repeatable Ranged method with Protect from Missiles and enough ammunition, food and prayer restoration.
Clear bodyguards after each kill and restock between trips until you reach 100 kills.

tasks.name: Collateral Damage
steps: Enter a private instance with chinchompas and position a bodyguard beside Kree'arra.
Attack the bodyguard so the chinchompa explosions also damage Kree'arra. Never directly attack Kree'arra during this kill.

tasks.name: Airborne Showdown
steps: Lower Kree'arra's health, then stop damaging him while you kill Flight Kilisa, Flockleader Geerin and Wingman Skree.
Finish Kree'arra while all three bodyguards are still dead; check that none has respawned before your final hit.

tasks.name: Swoop No More
steps: Use a private instance, Ranged attacks and protection prayers; keep attacking Kree'arra while avoiding melee contact.
Deal with Flight Kilisa without taking a melee hit. Neither Kree'arra nor any bodyguard may deal melee damage to you.

tasks.name: The Worst Ranged Weapon
steps: Bring a salamander and its matching tar, plus food and prayer restoration for a slower kill.
Deal every hit on Kree'arra with the salamander. Disable recoil and do not use thralls or damaging special-attack switches.

tasks.name: Feather Hunter
steps: Enter a private instance with enough ammunition, food and prayer restoration for an extended trip.
Kill Kree'arra 30 times in that room, clearing bodyguards between kills. Do not leave to bank before kill 30.

tasks.name: General Graardor Adept
steps: Bring a reliable solo or team setup. Use Ranged kiting or a designated melee tank to control Graardor's melee attacks.
Clear the bodyguards between kills and bank as needed until you have 50 kills.

tasks.name: General Graardor Veteran
steps: Use a practised Ranged kiting method or a team with a designated tank; handle the bodyguards after every kill.
Restock when necessary and repeat until 100 kills. They can be spread across separate trips.

tasks.name: Ourg Freezer
steps: Bring a binding or ice spell and lower Graardor's health before your final burst of damage.
Land an immobilizing spell, then finish Graardor before the immobilization ends.

tasks.name: Ourg Freezer II
steps: Prepare a Ranged or Magic setup with immobilization and enough space to keep Graardor from reaching you.
Control his movement from the start and kill him without allowing an attack on any player. Damage blocked by prayer still does not satisfy the restriction.

tasks.name: General Showdown
steps: Lower Graardor's health, then stop hitting him and kill Sergeant Strongstack, Steelwill and Grimspike.
Land the final hit on Graardor while all three bodyguards are dead; do not assume they cannot respawn.

tasks.name: Defence Matters
steps: Enter a private instance and use positioning and appropriate protection prayers to prevent all bodyguard damage.
Complete two consecutive Graardor kills in that instance, including safe cleanup of the bodyguards. Do not leave between kills.

tasks.name: Keep Away
steps: Use a private instance and a practised kiting or immobilization method to keep Graardor away.
Control all three bodyguards as well as the boss. Any damage from either the boss or a bodyguard invalidates the attempt.

tasks.name: Ourg Killer
steps: Prepare food, prayer restoration, ammunition or runes for 15 kills before entering a private instance.
Use your repeatable Graardor method, clean up bodyguards and stay inside through all 15 kills. Leaving to restock breaks the run.

tasks.name: Barrows Novice
steps: Bring a spade and supplies; search the mounds, fight the brothers and find the mound that leads into the tunnels.
Reach and open the central chest, then begin another run. Open the chest 10 times in total.

tasks.name: Barrows Champion
steps: Use Magic against the melee brothers and appropriate protection prayers against Ahrim and Karil; conserve supplies between crypts.
Navigate the tunnels and open the central chest on each run until you have opened it 25 times.

tasks.name: Can't Touch Me
steps: Bring Ranged or Magic plus a binding spell, and fight Dharok, Verac, Torag and Guthan from outside melee reach.
Keep them immobilized or behind a safespot until they die. A melee attack attempt can fail the task even if prayer blocks its damage.

tasks.name: Pray for Success
steps: Kill all six brothers without damage: protect against Ahrim's Magic and Karil's Ranged, and keep melee brothers at distance.
Safespot or immobilize Verac rather than relying solely on prayer. After all six die, loot the chest without taking brother damage.

tasks.name: Defence? What Defence?
steps: Choose a brother and prepare spells or a charged powered staff before opening his sarcophagus.
Deal only magical damage to that brother until he dies. Remove recoil effects and do not use other damage styles.

tasks.name: Just Like That
steps: Bring a damaging special-attack weapon and start with a full special-attack bar before opening Karil's sarcophagus.
Damage Karil only with special attacks. Stop attacking between specials so a normal attack cannot land; wait for energy if needed.

tasks.name: Faithless Crypt Run
steps: Drain your Prayer to zero before starting and bring food, defensive gear and Ranged or Magic for the melee brothers.
Kill all six and loot the chest while Prayer remains zero throughout. Do not use prayer-restoring potions or gear effects.

tasks.name: Reflecting on This Encounter
steps: Equip a mirror shield or V's shield before entering combat in Jormungand's Prison.
Kill one Basilisk Knight with Melee or Ranged while protecting against Magic. Keep the protective shield equipped.

tasks.name: Big, Black and Fiery
steps: Bring an anti-dragon shield and appropriate antifire protection to an adult black dragon location such as Taverley Dungeon.
Kill an adult black dragon; a baby black dragon does not satisfy the named target. Keep dragonfire protection active.

tasks.name: The Demonic Punching Bag
steps: Find a Bloodveld in the Slayer Tower and prepare Protect from Melee or a Ranged safespot.
Kill one Bloodveld. Its attacks use Magic-based accuracy, but Protect from Melee is the relevant protection prayer.

tasks.name: Brutal, Big, Black and Firey
steps: Go to the Brutal Black Dragons in the Catacombs with antifire protection, dragonfire protection and a Ranged weapon.
Use Protect from Magic and stay out of melee reach while killing one Brutal Black Dragon. Recheck protection before attacking.

tasks.name: Bryophyta Novice
steps: Bring a mossy key, an axe or secateurs, food and poison protection on a members world.
Weaken each growthling, then use the axe or secateurs on it. Defeat Bryophyta after the adds are cleared and open her chest.

tasks.name: Bryophyta Champion
steps: Gather five mossy keys and bring an axe or secateurs for the growthlings.
Clear the growthlings by weakening and finishing them with the tool, kill Bryophyta and open her chest. Repeat for five chest openings.

tasks.name: Protection from Moss
steps: Bring a mossy key, a growthling-finishing tool and prayer restoration.
Keep Protect from Magic active when Bryophyta dies. Clear growthlings as they appear and finish the boss before prayer runs out.

tasks.name: Quick Cutter
steps: Bring an axe or secateurs, wait for all three growthlings, and reduce each to finishing health without using the tool yet.
Use the tool on all three in quick succession; the last must die within 3 seconds of the first.

tasks.name: Preparation Is Key
steps: Use a free-to-play world for a simple attempt: Bryophyta cannot poison you there. On a members world, activate poison protection before entering and keep it active.
Use Protect from Magic, weaken growthlings and use an axe or secateurs to finish them. Kill Bryophyta without taking any poison damage.

tasks.name: A Slow Death
steps: On a members world, bring a weapon that can poison or venom Bryophyta and clear her growthlings.
Apply poison or venom, lower her health, then stop direct attacks and disable other damage sources so a poison or venom tick finishes her.

tasks.name: Fighting as Intended II
steps: Hop to a free-to-play world and use only equipment and supplies that work there. Bring a mossy key and an axe.
Weaken and finish the growthlings with the axe, then defeat Bryophyta while remaining on that free-to-play world.

tasks.name: Callisto Adept
steps: Use a reliable Callisto setup with food and an escape plan; the approach and fight involve Wilderness PvP risk.
Avoid bear traps and keep protection prayers ready while killing Callisto. Restock between trips until 10 kills.

tasks.name: Callisto Veteran
steps: Prepare a repeatable Callisto method and risk only gear you can afford to lose in the Wilderness.
Dodge bear traps, handle the boss's attacks and bank before supplies run out. Repeat until 20 kills.

tasks.name: Skotizo Champion
steps: Assemble a dark totem and use it on the central Catacombs altar to enter Skotizo's instance.
Fight Skotizo with appropriate protection prayers and destroy awakened altars when they hinder damage. Finish one kill.

tasks.name: Skotizo Adept
steps: Gather five assembled dark totems and use one at the central Catacombs altar for each attempt.
Handle awakened altars and incoming attacks, then repeat the fight until you have five Skotizo kills.

tasks.name: Demonic Weakening
steps: Watch all four altars while lowering Skotizo's health and destroy any that become active.
Before finishing Skotizo, confirm that no altar is active. Stop boss damage and clear a newly awakened altar if necessary.

tasks.name: Demon Evasion
steps: Use a practised method with protection prayers and positioning that prevents boss and summoned-creature damage.
Keep Skotizo at a safe distance when not protected from melee, manage awakened altars, and finish without taking any damage.

tasks.name: Demonbane Weaponry
steps: Equip a qualifying demonbane weapon, such as Arclight, before beginning the Skotizo fight.
Handle awakened altars and protection prayers normally, keeping the demonbane weapon equipped when Skotizo dies.

tasks.name: Up for the Challenge
steps: Choose a conventional Ranged, Magic or non-demonbane Melee weapon and remove all demonbane switches from your setup.
Destroy awakened altars when needed and kill Skotizo without equipping any demonbane weapon at any point.

tasks.name: Precise Positioning
steps: Bring chinchompas and lower Skotizo's health with your normal weapon while managing active altars.
Stop other damage sources, switch to chinchompas and let a chinchompa explosion deliver the final damage.

tasks.name: Cerberus Veteran
steps: Fight Cerberus with protection prayers, prayer restoration and enough run energy to move off lava pools.
Match protection prayers to the Summoned Souls when they attack. Bank as needed and repeat until 75 kills.

tasks.name: Cerberus Master
steps: Use a consistent Cerberus method: handle its attacks, switch prayers for Summoned Souls and move off lava.
Restock when food or prayer restoration runs low, and repeat until 150 kills across your trips.

tasks.name: Arooo No More
steps: Prepare a high-damage finishing sequence and save damaging special attacks for the soul-summoning window.
Kill Cerberus before any Summoned Souls spawn. A kill where ghosts appear does not count, even if you avoid their attacks.

tasks.name: Ghost Buster
steps: Let Cerberus summon its souls and watch their attack order. Match blue to Magic, red to Melee and green to Missiles.
Successfully protect against at least six soul attacks before killing Cerberus; keep enough Prayer for every blocked attack.

tasks.name: Unrequired Antifire
steps: Keep run energy available and move off the tiles targeted by Cerberus's lava attack.
Attack only from clear ground and finish the kill without lava-pool damage. Antifire does not replace moving away from lava.

tasks.name: Anti-Bite Mechanics
steps: Use Protect from Melee against Cerberus's melee attacks, including its opening attack sequence.
Time any prayer switches for Summoned Souls carefully and return to melee protection before the boss attacks. Take no melee damage.

tasks.name: Chaos Elemental Adept
steps: Take a conservative Wilderness setup with food and escape supplies; the Chaos Elemental is in deep multi-combat Wilderness.
Manage its teleports and equipment removal, keep attacking when safely positioned, and restock between trips until 10 kills.

tasks.name: Chaos Elemental Veteran
steps: Bring food and a safe escape plan for repeated Chaos Elemental fights in deep Wilderness.
Recover your position after teleports, re-equip displaced items if needed, and bank between trips until 25 kills.

tasks.name: Hoarder
steps: Fill every inventory slot before fighting; use food that leaves a container behind, such as curry, to keep the inventory full.
Do not create a free inventory slot during the kill. Finish the Chaos Elemental without any equipped item being removed.

tasks.name: The Flincher
steps: Set up a terrain-based flinching method before engaging; do not rely on one overhead prayer to block every Chaos Elemental attack.
Hide between attacks and only emerge to land a hit when it cannot retaliate. Finish with no damage from its attacks.

tasks.name: Chaos Fanatic Champion
steps: Use Ranged and Protect from Magic, with food and a Wilderness escape plan.
Move away from the green explosion projectiles and repeat the fight until 10 kills, banking as needed.

tasks.name: Chaos Fanatic Adept
steps: Take Ranged equipment, Protect from Magic and a conservative Wilderness inventory.
Dodge each green explosion attack, restock safely between trips and reach 25 Chaos Fanatic kills.

tasks.name: Sorry, What Was That?
steps: Attempt the kill alone or coordinate with everyone nearby so another player cannot be caught by the special.
Move off the landing tiles when green explosion projectiles are thrown. Finish without the explosion hitting anyone.

tasks.name: Praying to the Gods
steps: Bring food and start with restored Prayer. Use Protect from Magic and dodge green explosions; do not drink any potion that restores Prayer.
If Prayer runs low, restore it at the Wilderness Chaos Temple altar south of the Fanatic, then return. Complete ten kills without leaving the Wilderness or using a prayer-restoring potion.

tasks.name: Corporeal Beast Veteran
steps: Bring an appropriate spear on Stab, food and protection prayers; use a coordinated group if available.
Avoid the dark core and complete 25 Corporeal Beast kills over as many trips as needed.

tasks.name: Corporeal Beast Master
steps: Use an appropriate Stab spear and a repeatable solo or team method; avoid standing beside the dark core.
Restock between trips and repeat until 50 Corporeal Beast kills. These kills need not be consecutive.

tasks.name: Hot on Your Feet
steps: Tell every teammate to leave the dark core alive and move away as it lands near them.
Keep repositioning so nobody takes core damage, and finish the Corporeal Beast without anyone killing the core.

tasks.name: Finding the Weak Spot
steps: Bring a halberd with a damaging special attack and enough special energy. Lower the Corporeal Beast's health first.
Coordinate the finish so no teammate lands another killing hit, then use the halberd special attack for the final damage.

tasks.name: Chicken Killer
steps: Use a private or empty fight and prepare a self-sufficient solo setup with food, prayer restoration and any planned stat-reduction specials.
Handle the dark core yourself and kill the Corporeal Beast without another player assisting in the fight.

tasks.name: Crazy Archaeologist Champion
steps: Use Magic from a distance with Protect from Missiles and a Wilderness escape plan.
Move away from the Rain of Knowledge book explosions, then repeat and restock until 10 kills.

tasks.name: Crazy Archaeologist Adept
steps: Bring a Magic setup, Protect from Missiles and food; avoid standing in melee range.
Dodge the exploding books and bank between trips until 25 Crazy Archaeologist kills.

tasks.name: Mage of the Ruins
steps: Bring spells or a charged powered staff and remove recoil or other non-Magic damage sources.
Damage the Crazy Archaeologist only with Magic, using Protect from Missiles and moving away from his exploding books.

tasks.name: I'd Rather Not Learn
steps: Fight alone or coordinate with nearby players so everyone can dodge the special.
Move away when Rain of Knowledge begins and keep clear of the follow-up book explosions. Nobody may be hit by the special.

tasks.name: If Gorillas Could Fly
steps: Bring two combat styles and switch away from whichever style the Demonic Gorilla protects against.
Match your protection prayer to its attacks, step away from falling boulders and complete one kill.

tasks.name: Hitting Them Where It Hurts
steps: Bring a demonbane weapon alongside a second style for the gorilla's protection-prayer switches.
Lower its health, wait until it is not protecting from your demonbane attack style, and land the finishing blow with that weapon.

tasks.name: Deranged Archaeologist Novice
steps: Use Magic from range with Protect from Missiles in the Fossil Island swamp.
Move away from the exploding books when Learn to Read starts and repeat until 10 kills, banking as needed.

tasks.name: Deranged Archaeologist Champion
steps: Prepare Magic, food and Protect from Missiles for repeated Deranged Archaeologist fights.
Keep clear of Learn to Read book explosions and restock between trips until 25 kills.

tasks.name: Mage of the Swamp
steps: Bring spells or a powered staff and disable recoil or other non-Magic damage sources.
Deal only Magic damage to the Deranged Archaeologist while using Protect from Missiles and dodging his books.

tasks.name: I'd Rather Be Illiterate
steps: Keep enough open ground to move when the Deranged Archaeologist starts Learn to Read.
Leave the initial book landing area and avoid the follow-up explosions too. Finish without that special hitting anyone.

tasks.name: The Walking Volcano
steps: Find a Fire Giant in Brimhaven Dungeon; bring the axe and entry payment needed for that approach.
Use Protect from Melee or a Ranged or Magic safespot and kill one Fire Giant.

tasks.name: Galvek Speed-Trialist
steps: Use the Pool of Dreams in the Myths' Guild for a Galvek rematch. Prepare dragonfire protection, Ranged supplies and special energy.
Stay attacking between mechanics, switch to an appropriate finishing ammunition as his health falls, and dodge bombs and waves. Finish in under 3 minutes.

tasks.name: Grotesque Guardians Adept
steps: Bring Ranged for Dawn, Melee for Dusk and a rock hammer. Switch targets and styles as the phases change.
Avoid rockfalls, lightning and Dusk's prison, then repeat until 25 kills. Dawn cannot be killed with Melee.

tasks.name: Grotesque Guardians Veteran
steps: Use Ranged against Dawn and Melee against Dusk, carrying the finishing tool and enough supplies for each trip.
Handle the transition attacks and prison, then repeat until 50 kills. Bank between trips whenever needed.

tasks.name: Don't Look at the Eclipse
steps: Watch Dusk's blinding attack and move out of its marked danger area rather than relying on prayer.
Continue the remaining phases and finish the Guardians without taking damage from that attack.

tasks.name: Prison Break
steps: Keep run energy for Dusk's final phase and look for the opening when his prison surrounds you.
Leave through the opening immediately and finish the fight without prison damage. Do not run through the prison walls.

tasks.name: Granite Footwork
steps: Keep watching the floor while fighting Dusk, especially when Dawn starts dropping rocks.
Move off every rockfall landing area before impact and finish without taking rockfall damage.

tasks.name: Heal No More
steps: When Dawn creates healing orbs, stop to intercept them before they reach and heal her.
Absorb the orbs promptly, then finish both Guardians without Dawn receiving any orb healing.

tasks.name: Static Awareness
steps: Watch the marked lightning areas during the Guardians' transitions and move to clear ground before they strike.
Do not attack from a dangerous tile just to maintain damage. Finish without any lightning attack hitting you.

tasks.name: Done before Dusk
steps: Save damaging specials and a strong Melee setup for Dusk's final phase, and avoid lost time from prison damage.
Escape the first prison and keep attacking Dusk whenever safe. Kill him before he casts a second prison.

tasks.name: Perfect Grotesque Guardians
steps: Avoid Dusk's blinding attack and prison, Dawn's rockfalls and all lightning. Intercept Dawn's orbs so they cannot heal her.
Finish Dusk before his second prison. All six listed conditions must be satisfied in the same kill.

tasks.name: Perfect Grotesque Guardians II
steps: Prepare supplies for five consecutive kills and perform every Perfect Guardians condition: avoid listed attacks, prevent orb healing and beat the second prison.
Repeat five times in the same instance without leaving. A failed perfect kill breaks the sequence.

tasks.name: Grotesque Guardians Speed-Trialist
steps: Prepare Ranged and Melee switches, special energy and a rock hammer before starting.
Attack Dawn with Ranged and Dusk with Melee, switch promptly and avoid stuns or healing delays. Finish under 2:00.

tasks.name: Grotesque Guardians Speed-Chaser
steps: Set up quick Ranged and Melee switches and save damaging specials for useful vulnerable phases.
Keep damage flowing through the Guardians' phase changes, avoid stuns and prevent Dawn's healing. Finish under 1:40.

tasks.name: Grotesque Guardians Speed-Runner
steps: Practise the phase switches and have Ranged, Melee, special attacks and the finishing tool ready.
Minimize idle movement and attack delays while handling orbs and avoiding stuns. Kill both Guardians under 1:20.

tasks.name: From Dusk...
steps: Bring enough food, prayer restoration and ammunition for ten kills before entering.
Alternate Ranged on Dawn and Melee on Dusk, handle their specials, and complete ten kills without leaving the instance.

tasks.name: ... 'til Dawn
steps: Prepare supplies and ammunition for a twenty-kill trip and use a reliable phase-switching method.
Recover between kills inside the instance and complete all twenty without leaving to bank.

tasks.name: A Smashing Time
steps: Bring a rock hammer or another valid gargoyle-finishing tool to the Slayer Tower.
Lower a Gargoyle's health, then use the finishing tool to kill it. Ordinary weapon damage alone will not finish it.

tasks.name: Corrupted Gauntlet Veteran
steps: Prepare two attack styles, armour, cooked paddlefish and egniol potions inside the Corrupted Gauntlet.
Switch prayers and weapons for Hunllef while avoiding floor hazards and tornadoes. Complete five runs in total.

tasks.name: Corrupted Gauntlet Master
steps: Use a repeatable Corrupted Gauntlet preparation route for weapons, armour, food and potions.
Match Hunllef's attacks with the correct prayer, switch weapons against its protection prayer and complete ten runs.

tasks.name: Corrupted Gauntlet Grandmaster
steps: Prioritize reliable preparation with two damage styles, enough food and potions before entering Hunllef's room.
Avoid tornadoes and dangerous floor tiles while matching prayers and weapons. Reach fifty Corrupted Gauntlet completions.

tasks.name: 3, 2, 1 - Mage
steps: Watch Hunllef's Ranged and Magic attacks and have the matching protection prayer active before each hit.
Reactivate prayer after it is disabled and finish with no damage off prayer. Continue avoiding tornadoes and floor hazards for survival.

tasks.name: Perfect Corrupted Hunllef
steps: Use the correct protection prayer and only attack with a style Hunllef is not protecting against.
Avoid tornadoes, dangerous floor tiles and walking under Hunllef. Every listed condition must hold for the entire kill.

tasks.name: Defence Doesn't Matter II
steps: Craft weapons, food and potions but do not craft any armour during this Corrupted Gauntlet run.
Fight Hunllef unarmoured, keeping prayers correct and prioritizing tornado and floor avoidance. Do not make armour even if you do not equip it.

tasks.name: Egniol Diet II
steps: Prepare weapons, armour and plenty of cooked paddlefish, but do not make an egniol potion.
Conserve Prayer during Hunllef with carefully timed prayers and finish without brewing a potion at any stage.

tasks.name: Corrupted Warrior
steps: Gather the resources and upgrade all three corrupted armour pieces to perfected before the fight.
Equip the complete perfected corrupted set and keep it equipped when the Corrupted Hunllef dies.

tasks.name: Wolf Puncher II
steps: Make at most one attuned weapon; keep other weapons basic rather than upgrading a second one.
Use basic off-style attacks to change Hunllef's protection prayer, then return to your upgraded weapon. Bring enough food for the slower fight.

tasks.name: Corrupted Gauntlet Speed-Chaser
steps: Use a planned preparation route and gather only the weapons, food, armour and potions you will use.
Switch prayers and weapons promptly, avoid lost time to hazards and finish the complete run under 7:05, including preparation.

tasks.name: Corrupted Gauntlet Speed-Runner
steps: Practise a short preparation route and a two-style Hunllef fight before attempting the timer.
Avoid unnecessary gathering and keep attacks flowing while dodging hazards. Complete preparation and the kill in under 6:05.

tasks.name: Gauntlet Veteran
steps: Prepare two weapon styles, armour, cooked paddlefish and egniol potions inside the regular Gauntlet.
Match Hunllef's attacks with protection prayers and switch away from its protected style. Complete five regular runs.

tasks.name: Gauntlet Master
steps: Prepare two weapon styles, armour, cooked paddlefish and egniol potions inside the regular Gauntlet.
Use the correct protection prayer, change weapons when Hunllef protects against your style and avoid floor hazards. Complete 20 regular runs.

tasks.name: 3, 2, 1 - Range
steps: Prepare food and egniol potions so you can maintain protection prayers through the Hunllef fight.
Match each incoming attack with its protection prayer and reactivate prayer after Hunllef disables it. No attack may damage you through the wrong prayer.

tasks.name: Perfect Crystalline Hunllef
steps: Prepare two weapon styles and sufficient food and prayer supplies before entering the boss room.
Use the correct protection prayer and never attack Hunllef's protected style. Stay off damaging floor tiles, away from tornadoes and out from under the boss throughout the kill.

tasks.name: Defence Doesn't Matter
steps: Do not craft any armour, including pieces you would leave unequipped. Spend preparation time on weapons, paddlefish and egniol potions.
Use protection prayers and two attack styles. Prioritise avoiding floor hazards, tornadoes and stomps; bring extra food for the unarmoured fight.

tasks.name: Egniol Diet
steps: Do not craft an egniol potion. Prepare weapons, armour and enough cooked paddlefish to survive the fight.
Conserve your starting Prayer with careful flicking and turn prayers off while not needed. Switch weapons and dodge hazards normally; finish without having made a potion.

tasks.name: Crystalline Warrior
steps: Gather enough resources to craft perfected crystal body, legs and helm during preparation.
Equip all three perfected armour pieces before fighting Hunllef. Prepare weapons and food as well, and keep the full set equipped for the kill.

tasks.name: Wolf Puncher
steps: Make at most one attuned weapon; keep any other weapon basic rather than upgrading a second one.
Use basic off-style attacks to change Hunllef's protection prayer, then return to your upgraded weapon. Bring enough food for the slower fight.

tasks.name: Gauntlet Speed-Chaser
steps: Plan a short preparation route for weapons, food, armour and potions before starting the timed run.
Gather only what you will use, switch weapons promptly and attack while safely moving around hazards. Finish preparation and the kill in under 4:45.

tasks.name: Gauntlet Speed-Runner
steps: Practise an efficient preparation route and a two-style Hunllef fight before attempting the timer.
Cut unnecessary gathering and movement, and keep attacks flowing while dodging hazards. Complete the entire run, including preparation, in under 3:45.

tasks.name: Glough Speed-Trialist
steps: After Monkey Madness II, use the burning brazier in Zooknock's Gnome Stronghold house to replay Glough. Prepare your Ranged weapon, potions and special attack before entering.
Keep attacking through all three rooms, then move back into attack range after his final-phase pushes and pulls. Finish in under 2:30; excessive safespot waiting costs time.

tasks.name: A Greater Foe
steps: Choose a Greater Demon outside the Wilderness, such as one in the Catacombs of Kourend, and bring food.
Use Protect from Melee up close, or attack from a Ranged or Magic safespot. Kill one Greater Demon.

tasks.name: Not So Great After All
steps: Bring a demonbane weapon, such as Silverlight, Darklight or Arclight, and lower a Greater Demon to low health.
Equip the demonbane weapon and land the finishing blow with it. Stop other damage sources before the final hit so they cannot take the kill.

tasks.name: A Demon's Best Friend
steps: Choose a Hellhound outside the Wilderness, such as one in the Catacombs of Kourend, and bring food or prayer supplies.
Use Protect from Melee up close, or a Ranged or Magic safespot. Kill one Hellhound.

tasks.name: Hespori Adept
steps: Plant a Hespori seed in the Farming Guild patch and return when it is fully grown. Bring a Melee weapon, a fast Ranged weapon and poison protection.
Kill the flowers whenever they open, then resume attacking Hespori. Harvest and replant after each kill until you have defeated five Hespori.

tasks.name: Hesporisn't
steps: Bring a weapon with a damaging special attack and keep enough special energy for the finish.
Clear the flowers and lower Hespori to low health. Stop other damage sources, activate the special attack and use it for the killing blow.

tasks.name: Weed Whacker
steps: Equip a fast Ranged weapon, such as darts or a blowpipe, before a flower wave begins.
Attack each of the four opened flowers in quick succession without returning to Hespori between them. All four must die within five seconds.

tasks.name: Plant-Based Diet
steps: Turn all prayers off before fighting and keep quick prayers disabled. Bring food and poison protection to handle incoming damage.
Clear opened flowers promptly and kill Hespori with prayers off. Restoring Prayer after it drains does not undo a lost Prayer point.

tasks.name: Hespori Speed-Trialist
steps: Prepare a fast flower-killing weapon and your strongest available Melee damage before starting; apply combat boosts beforehand.
Switch immediately to each opened flower, then straight back to Hespori. Use damaging specials without delaying flower clears and finish in under 48 seconds.

tasks.name: Hespori Speed-Chaser
steps: Practise clearing each flower wave with a fast Ranged weapon and returning immediately to your Melee weapon.
Pre-pot and plan damaging specials for uninterrupted boss damage. Avoid extra eating and idle attacks while flowers are open; finish in under 36 seconds.

tasks.name: Obor Novice
steps: Bring a giant key, food and a suitable weapon to the Hill Giant lair beneath Edgeville Dungeon.
Enter Obor's room, use protection prayers and keep clear of knockbacks while killing him. Open his reward chest; the chest opening is what completes the task.

tasks.name: Obor Champion
steps: Collect a giant key for each attempt and bring food and a weapon to Obor's lair.
Kill Obor with protection prayers and controlled positioning, then open his reward chest. Repeat until you have opened the chest five times.

tasks.name: Sleeping Giant
steps: Bring a binding spell, such as Bind, Snare or a suitable ice spell, and lower Obor to low health.
Land the immobilising spell, then finish Obor before its effect expires. A splash does not immobilise him; confirm the spell has worked.

tasks.name: Back to the Wall
steps: Position yourself with the arena wall directly behind you so Obor cannot knock you far backwards.
Keep that wall position while attacking and using protection prayers. Finish without any knockback pushing you more than one square.

tasks.name: Squashing the Giant
steps: Bring food and prayer restoration, and use distance to keep Obor's Melee attacks out of reach where possible.
Match his Melee and Ranged attacks with the correct protection prayer. Any damage taken while using the wrong prayer fails the attempt; do not rely on tanking it.

tasks.name: Fighting as Intended
steps: Take a giant key, food and a usable free-to-play combat setup to Obor on a free-to-play world.
Keep behind a wall position to limit knockback, use available protection prayers and kill him. A members-world kill does not count for this task.

tasks.name: Alchemical Veteran
steps: Fight Hydra on a hydra Slayer assignment. Lure the green phase to the red chemical vent, blue to green, and red to blue.
Change protection prayers with its attacks, dodge acid and lightning, and walk clear of trailing fire. Bank between trips as needed until you reach 75 kills.

tasks.name: Alchemical Master
steps: Prepare long-trip combat, prayer and healing supplies for a hydra Slayer assignment.
Use the red, green and blue chemical vents for the green, blue and red phases respectively. Dodge each special attack and maintain protection prayers; repeat to 150 kills.

tasks.name: Unrequired Antipoisons
steps: In the opening green phase, lure Hydra to the red chemical vent while watching the acid attack.
Move away from the targeted tiles as acid is launched and stay out of the resulting pools. Complete all remaining phases without an acid-pool hit.

tasks.name: Lightning Lure
steps: Lure the blue-phase Hydra to the green chemical vent and leave yourself an escape route around the room.
Keep moving away from converging lightning rather than letting it surround you. Avoid every lightning hit, then finish the remaining phases normally.

tasks.name: Don't Flame Me
steps: Lure the red-phase Hydra to the blue chemical vent. When it moves to the centre, position yourself clear of the side walls of flame.
Once the tracking fire starts, turn run off and walk along a clear line ahead of it. Do not cross either side flame wall or the trailing fire; finish the kill.

tasks.name: Mixing Correctly
steps: Memorise the chemical order before entering: green Hydra to red vent, blue Hydra to green vent, red Hydra to blue vent.
Position the boss on the correct vent each phase and keep it away from the other vents. Finish without ever spraying Hydra with the wrong chemical.

tasks.name: The Flame Skipper
steps: Prepare your strongest available burst damage and save suitable specials for the red phase.
Lure red Hydra to the blue vent promptly, then push it into the final phase before it begins the flame-wall attack. Finish without any flame wall spawning.

tasks.name: Alcleanical Hydra
steps: Use the correct chemical vents and match every incoming attack with its protection prayer, including the faster final-phase changes.
Avoid acid pools, lightning, side flames, tracking fire and damaging vents. Continue to the kill without taking any damage.

tasks.name: No Pressure
steps: Equip only Dharok's greataxe as a weapon and enter the fight with no more than 10 Hitpoints. Plan protection prayers and hazard movement before attempting this.
Keep Hitpoints at or below 10 for the entire fight, use the correct chemical vents and avoid every damaging special. Do not swap weapons or heal above the limit.

tasks.name: Alchemical Speed-Chaser
steps: Pre-pot and plan a quick vent route: green Hydra to red, blue to green, red to blue. Save useful specials for uninterrupted damage.
Keep attacking between movement and prayer changes; prompt phase transitions reduce time lost to specials. Finish in under 1:45.

tasks.name: Alchemical Speed-Runner
steps: Practise the correct chemical route and fast prayer changes before the speed attempt. Prepare combat boosts and a burst-damage special plan.
Move the boss onto each correct vent immediately and keep attacking safely through transitions. Avoid lost time to acid, lightning or fire and finish in under 1:20.

tasks.name: Working Overtime
steps: Bring enough food, prayer restoration, ammunition or weapon charges for a 15-kill trip on a hydra assignment.
Use correct vents, protection prayers and hazard movement to conserve supplies. Kill Hydra 15 times without leaving its room; banking or teleporting out breaks the trip.

tasks.name: Fight Caves Veteran
steps: Bring a sustained Ranged setup, food and prayer restoration. Use terrain to separate enemies, kill prayer-draining bats early and protect against the magers.
At Jad, watch each attack and switch to Protect from Missiles for the stomp or Protect from Magic for the rear-up. Handle healers while keeping those switches steady and finish the cave.

tasks.name: Fight Caves Master
steps: Use a repeatable wave plan: block Melee enemies with terrain, remove bats early and protect against the magers.
At Jad, prioritise the correct protection prayer while dealing with healers. Restock between runs and complete the Fight Caves five times.

tasks.name: A Near Miss!
steps: Reach Jad with enough food to return to full Hitpoints. Choose one attack to deliberately take with prayers off and be prepared for a large hit.
Survive that unprotected hit, restore the correct protection prayer immediately and finish Jad. Do not attempt the hit while already low on health.

tasks.name: Denying the Healers
steps: Use terrain and distance to keep each Yt-MejKot out of Melee reach; attack it from a safe Ranged or Magic position.
Keep the Melee healers from engaging and healing during every wave, then defeat Jad. Clear injured enemies rather than letting a healer reach them.

tasks.name: Denying the Healers II
steps: Prepare strong burst damage for Jad and keep protection-prayer switches reliable before attempting this task.
As Jad reaches healer-spawn health, burst him down before any healer heals him, or immediately draw the healers off him. Finish the cave without a single Yt-HurKot heal.

tasks.name: You Didn't Say Anything About a Bat
steps: Check for Tz-Kih bats at the start of every wave. Kill them first from a distance, or block them behind terrain before attacking other enemies.
Never let a bat reach you and attack, even with protection active. Maintain that rule through all waves, then kill Jad.

tasks.name: Facing Jad Head-on
steps: Bring only Melee damage options, including a halberd if you want extra reach, plus food and prayer restoration. Do not use Ranged or Magic attacks on any wave.
Use terrain and protection prayers to handle each wave, then fight Jad while reacting to his Melee, Ranged and Magic attacks. Deal with the healers using Melee too.

tasks.name: No Time for a Drink
steps: Use practised prayer flicking to protect against attacks without Prayer draining, and keep Tz-Kih bats from attacking you.
Apply the same no-drain prayer control through every wave and Jad. A later potion cannot undo a lost Prayer point, so restart if Prayer drains.

tasks.name: Fight Caves Speed-Chaser
steps: Plan the wave spawns and bring weapons that efficiently clear both weaker enemies and the high-health magers.
Attack new spawns promptly, limit time spent arranging unnecessary safespots and prepare a quick Jad healer plan. Finish all waves and Jad in under 30:00.

tasks.name: Fight Caves Speed-Runner
steps: Practise a fast wave route and position for the next spawn before each wave ends. Use efficient damage against both small enemies and magers.
Minimise idle movement and eating without losing control of prayers. Clear Jad and his healers promptly to finish the full cave in under 26:30.

tasks.name: Kalphite Queen Adept
steps: Bring a Melee weapon for the first form, a Ranged weapon for the second, food and prayer restoration.
Fight each form with its suitable style and use protection prayers to reduce incoming damage. Restock between trips and repeat until you have 25 kills.

tasks.name: Kalphite Queen Veteran
steps: Prepare Melee and Ranged switches, food and prayer supplies, and a reliable route back to the lair.
Use Melee on the first form and Ranged on the second, healing before dangerous transitions. Bank as needed and repeat to 50 kills.

tasks.name: Chitin Penetrator
steps: Bring a defence-lowering special attack, such as a dragon warhammer or Bandos godsword, and land a successful reduction on the Queen.
Finish the kill after your reduction. In a group, ensure nobody else lowers her Defence after you; the most recent reduction must be yours.

tasks.name: Insect Deflection
steps: Bring Vengeance and lower the second form to low health. Stop attacking and remove other ongoing damage sources before the finish.
Cast Vengeance and survive an incoming hit that reflects enough damage to kill her. The reflected damage must deliver the killing blow.

tasks.name: Prayer Smasher
steps: Equip Verac's flail as your only weapon for both Queen forms. Wearing the full Verac set can help its attacks bypass defence and prayers.
Bring plenty of food and prayer restoration for the slower second form. Never switch to another damaging weapon; finish both forms with the flail.

tasks.name: King Black Dragon Novice
steps: Bring dragonfire protection, food and a suitable weapon. Travel through the Wilderness to the lair with only gear you are willing to risk.
Use Protect from Melee at close range and maintain dragonfire protection. The lair itself is outside PvP; restock between trips and reach 10 kills.

tasks.name: King Black Dragon Champion
steps: Prepare dragonfire protection, food and prayer supplies. Watch for players on the Wilderness approach; the KBD lair itself is outside PvP.
Use Protect from Melee when fighting up close and keep dragonfire protection active. Bank as needed and repeat until you have 25 kills.

tasks.name: Claw Clipper
steps: Bring dragonfire protection and enough Prayer to keep Protect from Melee active through the final part of the fight.
Kill KBD with Protect from Melee still activated when he dies. Do not turn it off early to save Prayer.

tasks.name: Hide Penetration
steps: Bring a weapon with a Stab attack style, plus dragonfire protection and food.
Select its Stab combat option and kill KBD with that weapon. Check the combat-style selection rather than assuming any sword attack counts as Stab.

tasks.name: Antifire Protection
steps: Equip an anti-dragon shield and drink an antifire potion before fighting. Bring food for dragonfire effects that protection does not remove.
Keep the shield equipped and the potion effect active until KBD dies. Refresh the potion first if it is about to expire.

tasks.name: Who Is the King Now?
steps: Enter a private KBD instance with enough food, prayer restoration, dragonfire protection and weapon charges for ten kills.
Conserve supplies with Protect from Melee at close range and keep antifire active. Complete all ten kills without leaving the instance.

tasks.name: Kraken Adept
steps: On a kraken Slayer assignment, bring a Magic weapon, food and enough charges. Wake the boss with a fishing explosive or by disturbing its tentacles.
Attack Kraken with Magic, healing through incoming damage. Bank between trips if needed and repeat until you have 20 kills.

tasks.name: Unnecessary Optimisation
steps: Wake Kraken and its tentacles, then stop damaging the main boss while all four tentacles are still alive.
Kill each tentacle first, checking all four are dead before finishing Kraken. Do not let ongoing boss damage take the kill early.

tasks.name: Krakan't Hurt Me
steps: Rent a private Kraken instance on an appropriate Slayer assignment. Bring Magic charges, food and healing supplies for 25 kills.
Wake and kill each Kraken with Magic, conserving food between spawns. Complete all 25 kills without leaving the room.

tasks.name: Ten-tacles
steps: Prepare a private Kraken trip with enough Magic charges and sustained healing for 50 kills; a healing Magic option can extend the trip.
Wake each boss and attack with Magic, using downtime to heal. Stay inside the same private room for all 50 kills.

tasks.name: One Hundred Tentacles
steps: Plan a long private Kraken trip with ample weapon charges and sustained healing, such as a blood-spell option alongside your main weapon.
Wake and kill each Kraken with Magic, heal during respawns and conserve supplies. Complete 100 kills without leaving the private room.

tasks.name: Master of Broad Weaponry
steps: Bring a valid Kurask damage option: a leaf-bladed weapon, broad ammunition or Magic Dart. Ordinary weapons and spells will not damage it.
Use Protect from Melee up close, or attack from a safespot with broad ammunition or Magic Dart. Kill one Kurask.

tasks.name: A Scaley Encounter
steps: Bring a full tier-5 Shayzien armour set, food and poison protection to reduce the danger from shaman acid attacks.
Use Protect from Missiles, keep clear of the shaman's jump landing and move away from explosive spawns. Kill one Lizardman Shaman.

tasks.name: Shayzien Protector
steps: Use the Molch shaman caves with full tier-5 Shayzien armour, poison protection and Protect from Missiles.
Keep outside Melee range and dodge every jump and acid attack. Kill a shaman that has damaged nobody; damage from its separate spawns is excluded by the task.

tasks.name: Mimic Veteran
steps: Enable Mimic encounters and open an eligible clue casket that offers the fight. Bring combat gear and supplies to the Mimic chamber beneath Watson's house.
Use protection prayers, keep away from thrown candy and summoned enemies, and continue damaging the Mimic. Defeat it once.

tasks.name: Giant Mole Novice
steps: Bring a spade and a safe light source, such as a lantern, to enter the mole tunnels beneath Falador Park.
Use Protect from Melee, follow the mole when it digs and repeat to ten kills. Restock whenever food or Prayer runs low.

tasks.name: Giant Mole Champion
steps: Bring a spade, a safe light source and prayer supplies. A Falador shield with the mole-locator benefit makes tracking digs easier.
Use Protect from Melee and follow each resurfacing quickly. Bank between trips as needed and reach 25 kills.

tasks.name: Why Are You Running?
steps: Prepare strong burst damage and damaging specials so you can finish with fewer attacks.
Keep pressure on the mole after each resurfacing and finish before a third burrow. Lost time does not help; each additional damaging hit can give another dig opportunity.

tasks.name: Hard Hitter
steps: Prepare a high-damage weapon and suitable burst specials. Disable poison, venom, thralls, recoil and other extra damage that would add hits.
Kill the mole with at most four damage instances dealt to it. Multi-hit attacks consume several of those instances, so favour large individual hits.

tasks.name: Whack-a-Mole
steps: Lower the mole's health and save burst damage for after a burrow. A mole-locator Falador shield helps you reach its next position.
Follow immediately when it resurfaces and deliver the remaining damage within ten seconds. Do not spend the window looting or re-equipping slowly.

tasks.name: Avoiding Those Little Arms
steps: Keep Protect from Melee active while the mole can attack and bring enough prayer restoration to maintain it.
Finish without the mole damaging anyone. If other players are present, they must also stay protected or out of reach throughout the kill.

tasks.name: Nightmare Adept
steps: Prepare Melee damage for the shield, Magic for the totems, prayer supplies and a parasite cure such as Relicym's balm or Sanfew serum.
Match protection prayers, dodge rifts and surge paths, cure parasites and avoid spores. Break the shield, charge the totems with Magic and complete the kill.

tasks.name: Nightmare Veteran
steps: Use a repeatable Nightmare method: Melee the shield, Magic the totems, and carry a parasite cure with food and prayer supplies.
Dodge rifts and surges, stay clear of spores and handle parasites promptly. Restock between attempts and complete 25 kills.

tasks.name: Nightmare Master
steps: Prepare both Melee and Magic damage, prayer restoration and a parasite cure; agree roles if fighting in a team.
Break the shield, charge totems and handle special attacks without wasting supplies. Bank as needed and repeat until you reach 50 kills.

tasks.name: Terrible Parent
steps: Enter a solo Nightmare fight with Relicym's balm or Sanfew serum and a weapon ready to kill parasites.
Cure the infection before a parasite emerges, then kill it promptly before it can heal Nightmare. Across the kill, parasites may restore no more than 100 of the boss's health.

tasks.name: Explosion!
steps: Bring an area-damage attack and wait for a pair of husks to spawn. Lower both carefully if needed without killing either early.
Position the pair within the same attack area and finish both with one area attack. Maintain the correct Nightmare protection prayer while handling them.

tasks.name: Perfect Nightmare
steps: Agree the perfect-kill rules with everyone: correct protection prayers, cure every parasite and stay clear of spores.
Avoid rifts, corpse flowers and surge paths through the whole fight. Any player taking a listed hit, an uncured parasite explosion or off-prayer damage fails the attempt.

tasks.name: Sleep Tight
steps: Enter Nightmare alone with Melee and Magic weapons, food, prayer supplies and a parasite cure.
Break the shield with Melee, charge totems with Magic and manage husks and parasites yourself. Dodge specials and finish without another player joining.

tasks.name: A Long Trip
steps: Agree the no-Prayer-drain rule with every player. Use practised no-drain prayer flicking, or keep prayers off and prepare to handle the additional damage.
Handle shield, totems and specials normally without anyone losing a Prayer point. Restoring Prayer afterwards does not undo a failure.

tasks.name: Nightmare (Solo) Speed-Trialist
steps: Prepare an efficient solo shield-and-totem rotation with Melee and Magic switches, boosts and parasite cures.
Clear husks and parasites promptly, keep damage flowing between safe movements and avoid time lost to special attacks. Finish the solo kill in under 23:00.

tasks.name: Nightmare (Solo) Speed-Chaser
steps: Practise solo phase transitions so Melee shield damage and Magic totem attacks begin immediately.
Plan specials, cure parasites and remove adds promptly without interrupting safe boss damage. Finish the solo fight in under 19:00.

tasks.name: Nightmare (Solo) Speed-Runner
steps: Prepare a fast solo Melee-and-Magic rotation and combat boosts before entering; plan which phases receive your strongest specials.
Minimise downtime between shield breaks, totems and add spawns while dodging hazards. Complete the solo kill in under 16:00.

tasks.name: Nightmare (5-Scale) Speed-Trialist
steps: Start a five-scale Nightmare fight with a coordinated five-player team. Agree totem assignments and who handles each add wave.
Use Melee on the shield and Magic on totems, with prompt switches and parasite cures. Keep all players attacking safely and finish in under 5:00.

tasks.name: Nightmare (5-Scale) Speed-Chaser
steps: Prepare a five-player Nightmare team with assigned totems, add handling and planned damage specials.
Switch immediately between shield and totem phases, cure parasites and avoid deaths or stalled add clears. Finish the five-scale fight in under 4:00.

tasks.name: Nightmare (5-Scale) Speed-Runner
steps: Practise a five-scale team rotation with coordinated shield damage, totem assignments and fast husk and parasite clears.
Pre-pot and use planned specials while keeping phase transitions immediate. Avoid lost damage to hazards and finish the five-scale kill in under 3:30.

tasks.name: Dagannoth Prime Champion
steps: Bring a Ranged weapon and Protect from Magic for Prime. Stay on the outer side of the room to avoid also attracting Rex and Supreme.
Kill Prime from range, maintain Magic protection and repeat to ten kills. Restock if Prayer or ammunition is running low.

tasks.name: Dagannoth Prime Adept
steps: Prepare Ranged damage, food and prayer restoration for Prime; keep out of the other kings' reach when possible.
Use Protect from Magic throughout his attacks and repeat to 25 kills. Bank between trips rather than running out of protection supplies.

tasks.name: Death to the Seer King
steps: Lower Prime to low health while keeping Rex and Supreme alive. Bring food to handle attacks from several styles.
Draw both Rex and Supreme onto you, then finish Prime while both are actively attacking you. Keep both attackers alive until Prime dies.

tasks.name: From One King to Another
steps: Bring a rune thrownaxe and save enough special energy. Lower Prime to finishing-hit health and position Rex close enough for the axe to bounce to Prime.
Stop other damage to Prime, target Rex and activate the rune thrownaxe special. The bounce from Rex must deliver Prime's killing blow.

tasks.name: Dagannoth Rex Champion
steps: Bring a Magic weapon and supplies, and isolate Rex from the other kings near the edge of the room.
Lure Rex into a terrain safespot and kill him with Magic while staying out of Prime and Supreme's attack range. Repeat to ten kills.

tasks.name: Dagannoth Rex Adept
steps: Prepare Magic charges or runes and a reliable Rex safespot on the room's outer edge.
Keep Rex blocked behind terrain and avoid drawing Prime and Supreme. Restock between trips as needed until you have 25 Rex kills.

tasks.name: Death to the Warrior King
steps: Lower Rex to low health while leaving Prime and Supreme alive. Bring food and suitable protection prayers for the combined attacks.
Draw Prime and Supreme onto you and finish Rex while both are attacking you. A safe isolated Rex kill does not meet this condition.

tasks.name: A Frozen King
steps: Bring a binding or ice spell and lower Rex to low health with Magic.
Land the immobilising spell, then finish Rex before its effect ends. Confirm the spell succeeded; a splash does not count.

tasks.name: Toppling the Diarchy
steps: Lower Rex and either Prime or Supreme to low health while keeping both alive. Coordinate finishing attacks with a partner, or prepare a suitable area attack.
Time the final hits so both kings die together. Disable lingering damage that could kill one early; two nearby but separate deaths do not count.

tasks.name: Sarachnis Novice
steps: Bring a Crush weapon, food and prayer supplies. Use Protect from Melee while adjacent to Sarachnis and Protect from Missiles during her webbed ranged phase.
Return to Melee range promptly after the web releases and handle summoned spiders as needed. Bank between trips and reach ten kills.

tasks.name: Sarachnis Champion
steps: Prepare a Crush weapon, food and prayer restoration for repeated Sarachnis kills.
Protect from Melee up close, switch to Missiles for the webbed ranged attack and return to the boss promptly. Manage summoned spiders and repeat to 25 kills.

tasks.name: Ready to Pounce
steps: Fight close to Sarachnis with Protect from Melee. When webbed, switch to Protect from Missiles for the ranged attack.
As soon as the web releases, return to Melee range so her next attack is Melee. Do not let distance cause two ranged attacks in succession.

tasks.name: Inspect Repellent
steps: Use Protect from Melee while next to Sarachnis and switch to Protect from Missiles when she webs you and attacks at range.
Return promptly after each web and finish without Sarachnis damaging any player. If others join, their prayer switches must also prevent her damage.

tasks.name: Newspaper Enthusiast
steps: Bring a weapon with a Crush attack style and select its Crush combat option.
Use protection prayers for Melee up close and Missiles during web attacks. Finish Sarachnis with the Crush weapon rather than switching to another style.

tasks.name: Commander Zilyana Adept
steps: Bring Ranged gear, stamina support, food and prayer restoration. Kite Zilyana around the room with Protect from Magic, keeping her and Starlight out of Melee reach.
Attack between movements and deal with the bodyguards after each boss kill. Restock between trips and repeat to 50 kills.

tasks.name: Commander Zilyana Veteran
steps: Prepare a sustained Ranged kiting setup with stamina support, food and prayer supplies.
Keep Zilyana and Starlight behind you while using Protect from Magic, then clear bodyguards between spawns. Bank as needed and reach 100 kills.

tasks.name: Commander Showdown
steps: Lower Zilyana to low health without finishing her, then turn to Starlight, Growler and Bree.
Kill all three bodyguards and finish Zilyana before any respawns. Stop lingering boss damage while clearing them so she cannot die too early.

tasks.name: Animal Whisperer
steps: Rent a private instance and use a practised Ranged kite to avoid Zilyana and Starlight's Melee attacks.

Prevent Growler's Magic and Bree's Ranged damage with correct protection switches, then clear them. Finish Zilyana without any boss or bodyguard damage; freezing a ranged attacker does not stop its attacks.

tasks.name: Moving Collateral
steps: Rent a private instance and bring chinchompas for indirect area damage. Position a bodyguard beside Zilyana so the blast can hit her too.
Always target the bodyguard with your chinchompas, repositioning as needed. Never click Zilyana to attack; defeat her entirely with the collateral damage.

tasks.name: Reminisce
steps: Rent a private instance and bring only Melee damage weapons, with ample food and prayer restoration.
Fight Zilyana and her bodyguards using Melee, keeping protection prayers active and healing before low health. Do not use Ranged or Magic damage at any point in the kill.

tasks.name: Peach Conjurer
steps: Rent a private instance with supplies and weapon charges for 50 kills. Bring Bones to Peaches tablets or the spell to turn bodyguard bones into healing food.
Kite Zilyana with Ranged and Protect from Magic, then clear bodyguards and convert their bones between spawns. Complete all 50 kills without leaving the room.

tasks.name: Scorpia Adept
steps: Bring Magic, freezing spells, antipoison and food for this Wilderness boss. Take only gear you are willing to risk on the approach and in the lair.
Freeze Scorpia to keep out of Melee range, remove or immobilise her healing guardians and continue Magic damage. Restock as needed and reach ten kills.

tasks.name: Scorpia Veteran
steps: Prepare Magic damage, freezes, antipoison and food for repeated Wilderness kills.
Keep Scorpia immobilised, handle healing guardians promptly and watch for other players. Bank between trips as needed and repeat to 25 kills.
